decisions.reason: The perfect binder sits close to the firm's core finishing portfolio and was presented on its own page, a visible commitment to its distribution offer that management would rather keep than write off, since any weak results can be blamed on the pandemic-era slump in print.
The fully automatic perfect binder fits the announced direction of integrated automation, so dropping it would contradict the firm's public strategy and expose the earlier decision as a mistake.
The inline and nearline booklet maker is central to the digital print finishing focus the firm has announced, and its prominent presentation and service ties make persistence the likely course.
